implementation_state: Canonical source mapping adopted; runtime/UI/effects/save evidence is separate.
path_convention: Source paths inside source records are relative to the named root; guidance links are relative to this JSON. Historical external evidence paths are absolute.

provenance.installed_version_role: Installation metadata, not executed checksum or a claim of1.20 compatibility.

donor_historical_inventory.role: Pre-existing recorded donor source arrays; not disposable output of this port task.

preserved_rules.seeds: 597 Shandong or743 Qingdao; require full eligible Chinese control and a first owner with another state. Do not add1117 as a substitute seed.
preserved_rules.snd_founding_land: All eligible SND-owned mainland states are founding land independent of support; includes actual RT56 Jinan1117. Existing eligible597/743 remain founding land regardless of owner.
preserved_rules.korean_protection: No ownership transfer if KOR owns OR controls any part; preserve is_fully_controlled_by=CONTROLLER and Chinese owner/controller guards.
preserved_rules.japanese_protection: Exclude JAP, direct Japanese subjects and subjects of Japanese subjects through the original donor guard; geography exclusions are independent of owner.
preserved_rules.legacy_601: Retain601 Tibetan Kham as existing KCH reconstruction core intent. TIB is not a support/donor tag; do not convert its current ownership to eligibility.
preserved_rules.men_region: Retain611/612/1122 in mainland geography/core intent. MEN is not added to the fixed sixteen donors; Japanese/owner/controller guards remain.
preserved_rules.pass_limit: Set bounded frontier passes to mainland_state_count=64; changing the number of target states does not change support ratios, costs or fixed rewards.
preserved_rules.recognition: KOR_New_China_Government reuses the same mainland-core helper; preserve its CHI-only annexation, existing KCH faction requirement and once-only contract.
preserved_rules.map_ownership: No changes to map/state/province/country histories owned by RT56; mapping adapts Korean-owned selectors and helper consumers only.
